At \(\lambda=i\omega\), the real/imaginary equations imply the positive-sine branch under \(P_k,S_k,\omega>0\). Replacing the printed \(R_k=-S_k\) and using \(\arccos(-c)=\pi-\arccos(c)\) proves an exact \(\pi/\omega_k\) shift; squaring explains why the frequency polynomial is unchanged. The zero mode is correctly excluded. The bundled exact-rational replay checks determinant and branch bookkeeping but is not used as the universal proof.
